decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service sits close to the firm's GIS integration expertise and was promoted to its own page in 2024, so the firm can interpret its early uptake and keep improving it.
The open GIS application development framework builds directly on the firm's core platform knowledge and its open-components strategy, although it was only mentioned and never given its own page.

The identity service for GIS applications draws on the firm's established know-how, gained its own page with a more specific value message, and fits the goal of integrating geospatial IT with enterprise systems.
The geodata business process consulting workshop uses the firm's certified trainers and consulting experience, costs little to keep running, and gives the firm direct customer feedback for learning.
